data.name: Ramvilash
data.gender_notes: Ramvilash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ram means 'God' and Vilash means 'Abode' or 'Grace'. This name signifies that the person carrying this name is blessed by the Gods and lives in their grace. The name Ramvilash carries the meaning “God's Abode, God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ramvilash usually hope their child will grow to embody god's abode, god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ram Vilash is a devotional name, often given to children who are believed to be blessed by the Gods. It is a reminder of the divine presence in one's life.
data.etymology: Ramvilash belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Abode, God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramvilash total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
